case_bindings.assertion_text: Chunk boundaries and reconstruction are identical across source packetizations.
Oversized streams or frames fail within the declared bound.
A lower checkpoint cannot replace a durable higher checkpoint.
A stalled graceful close forces termination within the explicit deadline.
Unsafe plaintext production or nonloopback test configuration is rejected.
Invalid telemetry fails strict validation before the database write.
An oversized or infinite row source is rejected before bulk database effects.
Stale or peer-mismatched authority cannot create an effect or outbox entry.
Different bytes for an applied migration fail before the changed SQL executes.
Disabled WAL protection or asynchronous commit is rejected before a durability-dependent effect.
Failed publication preserves pending work and replay does not repeat the effect.
Terminal or revoked authority cannot be restored by an ordinary request.
Connectivity without reconciliation does not restore primary authority.
Mismatched transport or database peer identity is rejected before any stream effect.
An exhausted finite pool times out; it never creates an unbounded extra lease.
Untrusted SQL text remains data and unadmitted identifiers are rejected.
Retry budget exhausts exactly and uncertain connection errors are not retried.
Mutating caller inputs cannot change a detached immutable authority snapshot.
Injected operation failure leaves the metrics table unchanged.
